scripts.db:migration:show:production: npm run build && node --env-file=.env.production.local node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:migration:run:production: npm run build && node --env-file=.env.production.local node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.test:release: npm run build:release && playwright test --config playwright.release.config.ts
scripts.test:race: npm run build && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.database.ts test/booking-race.db-spec.ts test/booking-concurrency.db-spec.ts test/booking-idempotency.db-spec.ts test/cancellation-concurrency.db-spec.ts --silent=false --reporter=verbose
scripts.db:migration:show: npm run build && typeorm migration:show -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:migration:run: npm run build && typeorm migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:migration:revert: npm run build && typeorm migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware src/ test/ browser/ playwright.config.ts playwright.release.config.ts
